content.english: The surviving remnant of the people, silenced and mute,
Imbibe from the Bible its principles.
Tremble before the decrees of the hidden and concealed God,
First and foremost. the Sabbath day, forever sanctified!

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno : beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.
With great joy, await a view of its presence!
A royal word, rightly timed—

content.hebrew: מַה טּוֹב וּמַה נָּעִים : חֹק אֵל וְדָתוֹ
content.transliteration: Ma tov uma na‘im : ḥoḳ el vedato
content.english: How good it is! How pleasant is the law of God, and His precepts,
Which He gave to the chosen people for all eternity.

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno, beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.
The esoteric meaning of the Sabbath’s rest—

content.hebrew: אֶל הַנְּבוֹנים שֵׂ־ : כֶל זָךְ תְּחַדֵּשׁ
content.transliteration: El hannevonim se- : chel zach teḥaddesh
content.english: May you give new understanding to the perceptive ones [to understand it].

content.hebrew: שֵׁם אֵל אֲשֶׁר הוּא נָח : שָׁבַת וְקִדֵּשׁ
content.transliteration: Shem el asher hu naḥ : shavat veḳiddesh
content.english: [It alludes to] the name of God, who rested, and hallowed

content.hebrew: יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִן : דּוֹר זוּ לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Yom hash-shevi‘i min : dor zu le‘olam.
content.english: The seventh day from this age evermore.

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno, beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.

content.hebrew: פִּ֒ינוּ בְּיוֹם זֶה יָ־ : שִׁיר רוֹב תְּהִלָּה
content.transliteration: Pinu beyom zé ya- : shir rov tehilla
content.english: Today our mouths will sing ample praises
For God, who began, completed, and put finishing touches on
His deeds in six days, both below and above—
And on the seventh day, He ceased forever.

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno, beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.

content.hebrew: בּ֒וֹ יִמְצָא שֹׁמְרוֹ : אֶת כָּל מְבַקְּשׁוֹ
content.transliteration: Bo yimtsa shomero : et kol mevaḳsho
content.english: One who keeps it will find all he desires :
Restraint of his body [gains] benefit for his soul;
He should fear lest God punish him for his sin—
May He never punish His children forevermore!

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno, beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.
One who plots to breach His fence
Shall bear his sin, for His Source is deep.
By keeping [the Sabbath], it will delight God, his Helper,
And He will hasten to bring him near; He will never reject [him].

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno, beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.
Those who sit in the darkness and the gloom of exile

content.hebrew: שׁ֒וֹבְתִים בְּיוֹם שַׁבָּת : אִישׁ תּוֹךְ גְּבוּלוֹ
content.transliteration: Shovetim beyom shabbat : ish toch gevulo
content.english: And cease labor on the Sabbath day, each within his border,
And yearn to abide by the prohibitions on that [day]—

content.hebrew: עַ֒ל זֶה שְֹכָרָם אֵל : יַכְפִּיל לְעוֹלָם :
content.english: For this, God will double their reward for all eternity!

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno, beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.

content.hebrew: הָ֒אֵל אֲשֶׁר אַתְּ רָם : עַל כָּל מְרוֹמִים
content.transliteration: Ha’el asher at ram : ‘al kol meromim
content.english: God—You, who are above all the heights :

content.hebrew: חַ֒זֵּ֒ק֒ יְדֵי אוֹם הַ־ : הוֹלְכִים בְּתָמִים
content.transliteration: Ḥazzeḳ yedé om ha- : holechim betamim
content.english: Strengthen the hands of the people who virtuously stride,
The offshoots of the three upright fathers—
Calm and assuage them for all eternity.

content.hebrew: בֵּינוֹ : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ : אוֹת הִיא לְעוֹלָם :
content.transliteration: Beno, beno levenenu : ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: Between Him—Between Him and us, it will be a sign forever.

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב : בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם
content.transliteration: Kakkatuv : Beni uven bené yisra’el ot hi le‘olam.
content.english: As it is written : It shall be a sign for all time between me and the people of Israel (Ex. 31 : 17).
